lines.trans: The new season of Twelve Singers enters pre-production in one month.
As always, we will preserve some of the finest elements of the show.
At the same time we will make adjustments to meet new market demand.
Next we present our comprehensive overhaul plan for Season Three of Twelve Singers.
I was in hospital these past few days; this proposal was indeed crafted by my team.
Yet frankly, nobody notified me that this proposal was going before a meeting today.
